net_liquidity.text: Net liquidity is $5.78T, -0.06T over ~3 months: draining — historically a headwind for risk assets.

global_cb.text: Fed + ECB + BoJ hold $17.6T (-0.5% in ~3 months): global liquidity is moving sideways.

m2_yoy.text: US M2 is growing 5.7% per year and accelerating: moderate money growth.

yield_curve.text: The 10Y−2Y spread is 0.45% (10Y−3M: 1.09%): positively sloped — the bond market is not pricing a recession.

hy_oas.text: High-yield spreads are at 3.24%: credit markets are calm — investors see low default risk. Complacency risk if this stays extreme.

dollar.text: DXY is at 101.93 (+1.1% in 3 months): the dollar is range-bound — not a major force either way right now.

cpi.text: Inflation is 3.7% (core: 2.8%) and rising: too hot — keeps the Fed hawkish, which pressures both bonds and risk assets.

unrate.text: Unemployment is 4.2% (+0.1pp off the 12-month low): the labor market is strong — supports spending and earnings.

fedfunds.text: The Fed's policy rate is 3.75% vs 5.24% on the 10Y: long rates sit well above the Fed — markets expect rates to stay high or growth/inflation to run hot.

spx.text: S&P 500 is 6.9% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

nasdaq.text: S&P 500 is 10.0% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

vix.text: VIX is at 16.4: normal — markets are functioning without stress.

gold.text: Gold is $4,162/oz (+7.6% in 1 year): moving with real rates and the dollar, as usual.

oil.text: WTI crude is $96 (+50% in 1 year): an oil spike — acts like a tax on consumers and pushes inflation back up.

btc.text: BTC $84,744 is above the 200-day ($71,427) and above the 200-week ($65,988): bull-market structure intact.

mvrv.text: MVRV is 1.59 (44th percentile since 2022): holders are modestly in profit — historically an accumulation zone.

mayer.text: Mayer Multiple is 1.19 (price ÷ 200-day average): above trend but within normal bull-market range.

rainbow.text: BTC sits -0.7σ from its long-term log growth path: below the long-term trend line — cheap relative to Bitcoin's own history.

realized.text: BTC trades 59% above the realized price ($53,163): the average coin is in profit, but not euphorically so.

fng.text: Crypto Fear & Greed is 65/100: greedy — fine in an uptrend, but chasing gets expensive.

stables.text: Stablecoin supply is $312B (+1.1% in 3 months): flat — no fresh inflows, rallies must be funded by rotation.

hashrate.text: Hashrate is at 68% of its all-time high: well below peak — miner capitulation, historically near cycle bottoms.

ethbtc.text: ETH/BTC is 0.0316 (+12.6% in 3 months): ETH is outperforming — risk appetite is broadening beyond Bitcoin (typical mid/late bull phase).

funding.text: BTC funding averages +0.003% per 8h (~+3% annualized): near zero — leverage is balanced.

open_interest.text: BTC open interest ≈ $0.0B (-100% in 30 days): a big deleveraging just happened — positioning is cleaner now.

long_short.text: 1.25 long accounts per short account on OKX: positioning is balanced.

sth_basis.text: BTC trades +16% vs the short-term holder cost basis ($73,033): recent buyers are in profit, so dips tend to get bought — healthy bull structure.

dominance.text: BTC's share of majors is 72.8% (headline BTC.D: 59.1%), +2.7pp off its 120-day low: no decisive rotation signal.

dex_volume.text: DEX volume averages $10.2B/day (+41% vs the prior 6 months): on-chain trading is accelerating — real usage confirming the price move.

defi_tvl.text: DeFi TVL is $96B (+31% in 90 days): capital is being redeployed into DeFi — the credit rebuild that powers wealth-creation phases.

etf_flows.text: Spot-BTC ETFs: +723M over 7 days, +4,806M over 30 (cumulative $58B since launch): the institutional pipe is net-buying — structural demand under the market.

regime.name: Liquidity tailwind · Risk-on
regime.summary: Central banks are adding liquidity and markets are embracing risk. Historically the most rewarding regime for risk assets — and where crypto has done its best work.
playbook: Historically favored: equities, crypto, high-beta assets
Classic mistake: being under-invested and chasing late

phase.name: Early Bull
phase.why: Trend reclaimed and 6 of 9 early-bull checks are passing, while price is still 32% below the prior high — the early phase profile.

guide.signature: Trend reclaimed (golden cross, 50-week), BTC leads and dominance rises, recent buyers back in profit, first pockets of speculation return while the crowd is still skeptical.
guide.playbook: Historically the phase where patient positioning in majors and high-conviction themes paid best — accumulation into strength, wide stops, no chasing. The edge is building positions before the crowd believes it.
guide.exit_tell: Graduates into Wealth Creation when stablecoins, credit and on-chain activity expand together and price approaches old highs.
